title: Selective Locality & Boundary Crossing Benchmark
goal: Empirically evaluate whether the composite system correctly classifies and routes mutations to the minimal required architectural layer (LIN internal, LIN effect sandbox, LIN contract, or AINL DAG structure) without under- or over-propagating changes.

mutation_tiers.name: Pure Local Implementation
mutation_tiers.description: Alpha-renaming, local constant folding, AST-equivalent helper refactor

mutation_tiers.name: Effect Sandbox Change
mutation_tiers.description: Node introduces new effect (e.g. state_read or log_audit) requiring effect boundary verification

mutation_tiers.name: Type Signature & Return Contract Change
mutation_tiers.description: Node modifies exported return signature, requiring transitive downstream consumer re-typecheck

mutation_tiers.name: Structural Topology Mutation
mutation_tiers.description: Workflow requires inserting an intermediate aggregator node, splitting branches, or rerouting edges

conditions.label: Selective Composite (AINL + LIN)
conditions.description: Routes mutations strictly to the minimal required layer using LIN semantic hashcons + AINL DAG classification

conditions.label: Coarse Workflow Baseline (AINL Standalone)
conditions.description: Treats node modifications as task-level churn without fine-grained effect/symbol classification
